Summary: The Haverhill Police Department started using PredPol (now Geolitica) predictive policing technology in 2014.
The Haverhill Police Department acquired automated license plate readers before recieving a grant for more systems in 2010.
The Haverhill Police Department has access to SoundThinking's CrimeTracer (formerly Coplink X) investigative platform through a statewide contract announced in December 2022.
